name: Fujian Apex Software Co.,LTD
summary: Fujian Apex Software Co.,LTD specializes in delivering sophisticated platform software and IT services throughout China. Its core offering is LiveBOS, a comprehensive business process management (BPM) platform. This system is engineered for diverse applications across the financial industry, spanning securities, futures, funds, banking and trust operations, electronic trading, and asset management. Headquartered in Fuzhou, China, the firm has been a market presence since its establishment in 1996.
